searchText: You can read more about Portal Network on https://ethportal.net/ , but majority of Portal Network is no longer actively maintained/reseearched. The only part that is currently worked on is integration of modified history network inside (some) execution clients. Check recent messages for most up-to-date status And there is no other rust client (other then trin).
